dataset: Tiriac et al. 2018 PDAC patient-derived organoid drug AUC tables

source_files.table: Table S1A-D cohort/genomic descriptors; not used as fluxes

observation_unit: PDO model; only PDO IDs with both chemotherapy and targeted-agent AUC profiles

unmatched_source_ids_excluded_without_im.cohort_sheet_check: S1A marks hT83 Chemo=YES/Targeted=NO and hT96 Chemo=NO/Targeted=YES

id_normalization: leading/trailing whitespace stripped; S4B hF74 has a trailing space and matches S4A hF74
row_order: S4A published sample order preserved for shared PDO IDs; targeted rows joined by normalized exact PDO ID
axis_note: No physical time axis is supplied; the pipeline constructs its progress axis from each selected drug-AUC control. T0 is not interpreted as a temporal or biological transition in this cross-sectional dataset.
response_metric: The source key states the displayed values are AUC. Values are copied without transformation; no new sensitivity cutoff is applied.

excluded_source_annotation.reason: categorical source annotation; excluded from numeric flux matrix because its coding/threshold is not specified in the copied AUC key

planned_pipeline_test.estimator_profile: Cohen-d-only as configured by the source pipeline
planned_pipeline_test.design: fixed Gemcitabine AUC target against each of the other numeric drug-AUC columns as control, preserving all 26 AUC profiles as the multiflux input
planned_pipeline_test.selection_note: Gemcitabine is the prespecified standard-chemotherapy anchor for this first all-controls pass. This is an exploratory response-profile analysis, not a drug ranking or clinical recommendation.
